messages.author: Brian Radak
messages.body:
Hi all,
I accidentally stumbled across a possible bug in parmchk2 - it looks like
specifying -s gaff2 occasionally grabs the original gaff parameters by
mistake.
This appears to happen stochastically for the same mol2 input with GAFF2
types (antechamber seems to always get this assignment right), but then the
frcmod from parmchk2 occasionally assigns parameters to new GAFF2 types by
analogy with old GAFF types (specifically nu and nv get the old nh
parameters).
Has anyone seen this before? I have a MWE.
Cheers,
Brian

messages.author: Brian Radak
messages.body:
Sorry for the rapid posts.
Further update - this appears to _not_ occur with "-s 2" (0/100 attempts)
but occurs alarmingly frequently with "-s gaff2" (31/100 attempts!!).
Maybe this is a compiler issue with strcmp?
I suppose I should also add that I'm running Ubuntu 22 under WSL2, so my
setup is potentially unusual.
Brian
